text: fix all these label with strings in the hmsc-int editor only [Image #1] i cant even see the full string even when im typing
resolution: Fixed the hmsc-int model editor dialog field layout so LCField rows claim the full dialog width and put controls in a growing value lane. This makes string inputs like Compile Asset > Label show the full available width while typing, and applies to both the current studiokit controls and the legacy inline Studio.tsx copy.
